title: Norway – Food, beverages, tobacco and related products – Foodstuffs
description: Background In addition to the provisions in the tender documentation and information in kgv (Hyyr), refer to the annex competition provisions. The aim of the procurement is to enter into framework agreements that help Innlandet County (IFK) achieve food and meal meals for full, healthy and affordable meals with low environmental and climate footprint and a clear local affiliation, cf. the Inland Food Promise that IFK signed in 2025. Breakfast and lunch that meets the plate model sums up how full-fledged meals are put together for a health promoting and environmentally friendly food consumption. Water and milk is the recommended drink. The goal in the canteens, the largest buyer on the contract, is that the healthy alternatives and meals should be the most affordable and easily available. This involves, among other things, promoting a high procurement of grain and coarse cereals, potatoes, vegetables, fruits, berries, legumes, seeds and nuts, fish and seafood, as well as certified food and beverages (including organic, MSC/ASC and Fairtrade where relevant). Increased use of goods produced in Inland and Norway shall also be facilitated. At the same time, the procurement shall cover the need for raw materials within all food groups, so that teaching in restaurant and food subjects can be carried out in a professionally good way. Sustainability, public health, democracy comprehension and life mastering are interdisciplinary topics that will permeate education in county schools. The framework agreements for food articles shall contribute to supporting the contracting authority ́s aims within these areas. The contracting authority would like to enter into agreements with tenderers who offer high quality, good service and relevant competence and who actively contribute to the desired consumption and ordering pattern. This includes good digital solutions, clear product information and labelling schemes, as well as offers of courses, guidance and statistics that can support informed choices at orderers and users. IFK would like tenderers to use the competition to show how their offer of product selection and prices, internet shop, brand schemes/information, campaigns, promotional measures, courses and/or consumption statistics can contribute to promoting the desired consumption and ordering pattern. At the same time, the procurement shall contribute to limiting the consumption of goods with low nutritional value, such as candy, snacks, sweet beverages and similar products. The Contracting Authority uses the Hyyr portal. This is where the competition is published, tender documentation will be published, communication will take place and additional information will be published. It is crucial that you have registered interest in the tender contest in Hyyr in order to participate in the communication and additional information that is published. The entities/locations included in this contract are listed in the annex competition provisions. In addition to the county ́s entities, the procurement includes the following entities: A/S Kirkegaten 74 v/canteen Post Box 153 2626 Lillehammer Org.nr no.: 930 635 944 Description of the assignment The assignment is for the delivery of food articles to Innlandet county and other participating activities in the contract period. The framework agreement shall allow the contracting authority to prioritise goods that build up during healthy meals, sustainable procurements and the desired turn in the consumption. It is also important that the delivery supports the need for quality, delivery security and practical feasibility. The procurement has a significant extent and it shall cover the contracting authority ́s total need within the contract area. Contract period The framework agreements will be valid for 2 years. The contracting authority has a unilateral right to extend the contract for a further 1+1 year. If the contracting authority decides not to extend the contract, the contracting authority shall provide written notification to the tenderer at the latest three months before the contract period expires. If the maximum call-offs (see the attached contract proposal) are reached before the contract period expires, the contracting authority reserves the right to conclude the contract, regardless of the contract ́s term. The value of the competition The competition is divided into seven sub-contracts. The estimated maximum value for the framework agreements is calculated as the sum of each sub-contract ́s maximum values: Part 1 'Groceries': NOK 88,715,000 Part 2 'Berries, fruit and vegetables': NOK 22,880,000 Part 3 'Dairy Products': NOK 45,760,000 Part 4 'Meat products': NOK 17,160,000 Part 5 'Fowl, poultry and eggs': NOK 8,580,000 Part 6 "Mineral water and drinks": NOK 5,750,000 Part 7 "Fish and seafood": NOK 6,000,000 The total maximum value of the competition and the accompanying framework agreements is NOK 194,845,000 excluding VAT. The value estimate is based on the sum of the maximum values for each sub-contract. The stated volume represents the estimated annual turnover and is based on previous figures. The figures are only a guideline and do not represent any purchasing obligation for the contracting authority. Changes in technology, organisation, budget and routines can affect the total volume. Political guidelines within food articles can affect consumption patterns in the contract period, for example, on topics such as environment, public health, stand-by and regional production. This can be done, among other things, through the follow-up of Innlandets Matløfte, new national professional guidelines from the Norwegian Directorate of Health on food and meals in sixth form colleges or other guidelines.

title: Norway – Construction project management services – Procurement of an assistant project manager (APL) / builder ombudsman (BHO) and HSE coordinator
description: Background Aukra municipality is situated on the Romsdal coast and has a population of approx. 3,800. The municipality consists of both mainland and islands and has a rich cultural offering with active voluntary teams and organisations. Aukra municipality hereby invites tenderers to a competition for the provision of services such as assistant project manager (APL) / builder ombudsman (BHO) and SHA coordinator in the engineering design and execution phase for the Aukra sports hall project. The SHA coordinator role shall also include four minor projects: Upgrading Riksfjord School, Clearing of Abandoned Purpose-Built Buildings, Redevelopment of Riksfjord School and Riksfjord Sports Park - Outdoor Work. The Aukra sports hall project is in its early phase and is planned to be completed by the end of 2028. The builder for the projects is Aukra municipality. The tender documentation consists of: · Tender Invitation · Tender form · Performance Description Description of the assignment APL shall also have the role of BHO and assist PL as needed and requested by the builder. Various resources shall be offered for the APL/BHO and SHA coordinator roles. APL/BHO shall/can function as Aukra municipality ́s representative in the project Aukra sports hall against contractors, users, public bodies etc. Requirements and examples of services from the builder's representative are stated in the attached performance description. The service description is a guideline. Assignments can be further specified before the contract is signed and must be expected to be adjusted continuously in accordance with the project ́s needs. The assignment will be paid in accordance with hours used based on agreed hourly rates. Hours shall only be invoiced for the used time for work performed. Tenderers shall have the necessary capacity, experience, professional and technical competence to fulfil the assignment. The SHA coordinator shall also include the projects: · The upgrading of Riksfjord School · Redevelopment Riksfjord School · Redevelopment deprived of purpose-built buildings · Riksfjord Sports Park - Outdoor works. The contracting authority reserves the right to use APL/BHO for these projects as needed. An environmental mapping report and re-use mapping have been prepared for both of the clearance projects. Construction and construction work is planned for 3 of the projects at the same time that Aukra Arena (nine is the football pitch) shall be in use. It is therefore important that the SHA coordinator makes good SHA plans for the projects and follows these well under the ongoing building and construction activities that will be in the period Q1-Q2 in 2027. There shall be weekly follow-up on site during this period. The project Riksfjord stadion - Athletics facility and artificial grass cover is ongoing, and a contract has been signed with the ground contractor Odd Småge AS. The project has been completed and it shall be completed by the summer holiday 2027. The project Riksfjord Stadium - athletics facility and art grass cover is not included in the assignment. See the attached documents for further details.

Předmětem realizace Stavby je rekonstrukce stávajících a výstavba nových provozních ploch a zařízení pro zvýšení bezpečnosti leteckého provozu na letišti Leoše Janáčka Ostrava. title: Belgium – Environmental planning – Opmaak van een gemeentelijk beleidsplan ruimte Beerse incl. PLAN-MER
description: Voorwerp van deze diensten: Opmaak van een Gemeentelijk Beleidsplan Ruimte Beerse (GBRB), inclusief plan-MER. Toelichting: Het gemeentelijk ruimtelijk structuurplan Beerse werd goedgekeurd in 2007. Hoewel de ruimtelijke principes en de visie uit dit structuurplan in bepaalde mate nog steeds relevant zijn, is een herziening van onze visie op ruimte nodig. Deze herziening dient om de huidige maatschappelijke en klimatologische uitdagingen te integreren en de verdere groei en ontwikkeling van de gemeente op een duurzame en slimme manier aan te pakken. Het beleidsplan ruimte wordt een nieuw kader dat de ruimtelijk ontwikkeling van de gemeente voor de komende jaren zal sturen. In een strategische visie wordt de gewenste ruimtelijke ontwikkeling op lange termijn vastgelegd. Beerse wordt ruimtelijk gekenmerkt door een sterke wisselwerking tussen open ruimte, wonen en economische ontwikkeling. De gemeente beschikt over uitgestrekte landbouw-, natuur- en bosgebieden die een belangrijke landschappelijke, ecologische en recreatieve waarde hebben. De woonkernen van Beerse en Vlimmeren bieden een aantrekkelijk woonmilieu en vervullen, mede door hun ligging nabij Turnhout, een belangrijke rol binnen de regionale woonstructuur. Daarnaast vormt Beerse een economische motor binnen de Noorderkempen dankzij de aanwezigheid van belangrijke bedrijven en bedrijventerreinen, terwijl de kanaalzone langs het Kanaal Dessel-Turnhout-Schoten fungeert als een belangrijke ruimtelijke en economische structuurdrager. De uitdaging voor de toekomst bestaat erin om kwalitatieve woonontwikkelingen, economische groei en de vrijwaring van de open ruimte op een duurzame manier met elkaar in evenwicht te brengen. Voor drie nader te bepalen thema’s zal deze visie vervolgens worden vertaald in beleidskaders waarin de ruimtelijke keuzes voor de middellange termijn concreter worden benoemd. Het beleidsplan ruimte vormt een groeiend beleidsplan. Beleidskaders moeten in een latere fase op eenvoudige wijze kunnen worden toegevoegd of bijgestuurd. Voor de gemeente is het zeer belangrijk dat de beleidskaders concreet en realiseerbaar zijn. Samen met het beleidsplan ruimte wordt een strategisch plan-MER opgemaakt dat de potentiële milieueffecten van het beleidsplan ruimte in kaart brengt en erover waakt dat de algemene integrale impact positief is en negatieve effecten vermeden worden of geminimaliseerd door milderende maatregelen. De opdracht is zowel methodologisch, procesmatig als inhoudelijk. We vragen ook uitdrukkelijk ondersteuning bij het uitzetten van een communicatie- en participatietraject. Plaats van dienstverlening: De Loods, Dennenlaan 1, 2340 Beerse

title: Germany – Training seminars – Bereitstellung einer KI-Kompetenzplattform sowie Durchführung von KI-Grundlagen- und KI-Aufbauqualifizierung
description: Das Jobcenter Neue Wege Kreis Bergstraße ist Eigenbetrieb des Kreis Bergstraße. Es führt für den Kreis das Förderprojekt KI_Hub Kommunal durch, das im Rahmen des Förderprogramms starke Heimat Hessen aus Landesmitteln gefördert wird. KI_Hub Kommunal ist hierbei ein Verbundprojekt kommunaler Jobcenter und der K4K eG als Umsetzungspartner. Im Rahmen des Projekts "KI_Hub Kommunal" wird eine interkommunale Gemeinschaft von kommunalen Organisationen, insbesondere kommunalen Jobcentern, beim systematischen Aufbau von Kompetenzen im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) unterstützt. Die Projektgemeinschaft umfasst mehrere kommunale Träger, die unter der federführenden Beteiligung vom kommunalen Jobcenter Neue Wege gemeinsam Standards, Strukturen und Befähigungsangebote im Umgang mit KI etablieren. Mit zunehmender Verbreitung von KI-Anwendungen in der Verwaltungs- und Beratungsarbeit entsteht ein erheblicher Qualifizierungsbedarf in der Breite der Belegschaften. Gleichzeitig ergeben sich aus Artikel 4 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 ("EU-KI-VO" bzw. "EU AI Act") konkrete Pflichten der beteiligten Organisationen, ein angemessenes Maß an KI-Kompetenz ihrer Mitarbeitenden sicherzustellen. Ziel der Beschaffung ist der Aufbau einer nachhaltigen, gemeinschaftlich nutzbaren Qualifizierungsarchitektur, bestehend aus einer zentralen KI-Kompetenzplattform sowie einer darauf aufsetzenden Grundlagen- und Aufbauqualifizierung. Die Lösung soll skalierbar, datenschutzkonform und über die Projektlaufzeit hinaus weiterführbar sein und einen wirksamen Beitrag zur Erfüllung der KI-Kompetenzpflicht nach Art. 4 EU-KI-VO leisten.

title: Munitions Maintenance and Inspection Facility and Conventional Munitions Cube Storage Addition, HIANG, JBPHH, HI
description: This is a Solicitation Notice, Request for Proposal. Single Project RFP Set-Aside for Small Businesses NAICS Code: 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The Hawaii National Guard intends to issue a Request for Proposals (RFP) to award a single firm fixed-price contract for services, non-personal, to provide all plant, labor, transportation, materials, tools, equipment, appliances and supervision necessary for the Construction of KNMD209085 Munitions Maintenance and Inspection Facility and KNMD209086 Conventional Munitions Cube Storage Addition located on the Hawaii Air National Guard campus, at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam (JBPHH), Hawaii. These projects will be concurrent. KNMD209085 Munitions Maintenance and Inspection Facility - Construct a new Munitions Maintenance and Inspections facility by utilizing conventional design and construction methods to accommodate the facility mission. This project has a statutory cost limitation $14M for Unspecified Minor Military Construction (UMMC) Project - Adjustment of Dollar Limitations for Location pursuant to 10 USC Section 2805. Project square footage is estimated at 2,400 SF. Work covered in this project includes but is not limited to: Micro-pile Foundations: Specialized foundation engineering featuring micro-piles to mitigate challenging soil conditions and ensure seismic structural integrity. Cast-in-Place Concrete: Constructing robust concrete slab-on-grade, concrete walls, capping beams, and associated structural masonry elements. Structural Framing and Enclosure: Utilizing cold-formed metal framing, insulated metal wall panels, and structural steel support systems. Roofing: Installation of high-performance standing seam metal roofing, complete with prefinished gutters, downspouts, and weather barrier wraps. Specialized Systems: Installation of mechanical HVAC systems (including specialized 20-ton air conditioning systems), interior plumbing, lightning/grounding protection, and communication infrastructure. Fire Protection: A complete fire alarm-mass notification system and wet-pipe sprinkler suppression system. In addition to the base work described above, the solicitation will include the following option line items: 1. MAC Pad - Construct 1,167 SY concrete pad for the Material Assembly Center (MAC), required for constructing munitions, along with new asphalt pavement for access and egress to the facility maintenance bays. KNMD209086 Conventional Munitions Cube Storage Addition - Construct an addition to the Munitions Cube Storage Facility (B3552) utilizing conventional design and construction methods to support the F-22 mission. This project has a statutory cost limitation $14M for Unspecified Minor Military Construction (UMMC) Project - Adjustment of Dollar Limitations for Location pursuant to 10 USC Section 2805. Project square footage is estimated at 1,320 SF. Work covered in this project includes but is not limited to: Substructure and Enclosure: Micro-pile foundations, concrete wall structures, cast-in-place concrete slabs, and 12 in. thick concrete walls designed for high-hazard storage specifications. Framing and Roofing: Structural steel framing, roof joists, and standing seam metal roofing matching existing facility standards. Exterior Elements: Erection of new asphalt pavement adjacent to the existing facility access to provide adequate logistics and material handling access around the new facility addition. Specialized Protection: Maintenance facility lightning and grounding protection systems, along with integrated fire detection and alarm reporting systems connected back to the base reporting system. APPLICABLE TO BOTH PROJECTS: RAB Lighting exterior wall packs and area lights are sole source/brand name specific for compatibility with existing installation systems (noted justifications will be included with solicitation). Project Phasing and Security Gates: The contractor will be required to erect a temporary security fence around the construction zone in accordance with the project staging and phasing drawings. Escort Requirements: Escort personnel shall be required when erecting the temporary security fence, performing work occurring outside the temporary security fence, and connecting utilities to the existing system. Secured Zone Access: Once the temporary security fencing is approved and accepted by the Contracting Officers Representative (COR), no escort shall be required within the active secured work zone during construction, allowing the contractor to work within the secured boundary unimpeded. The magnitude of construction is between $10,000,000 and $25,000,000 total. KNMD209085 Munitions Maintenance and Inspection Facility project duration will be 733 calendar days after notice to proceed to include inspection and punch list. KNMD209086 Conventional Munitions Cube Storage Addition project duration will be 456 calendar days after notice to proceed to include inspection and punch list. This action is being solicited as a set-aside 100% for Small Businesses. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 236220, with a small business size standard of $45,000,000. A pre-proposal conference is scheduled 01 October 2026, 08:00 am local time, location to be provided in the solicitation. Interested contractors are encouraged to attend and shall follow conference registration and base access requirements shown in the solicitation. A site visit will follow the preproposal conference. All questions for the pre-bid conference must be submitted by 28 September via email to cezar.y.deveas.mil@army.mil and copy to anthony.g.reyes1.civ@army.mil. The solicitation closing date is 28 October 2026. Actual dates and times will be identified in the solicitation. The source selection process will be conducted in accordance with the Source Selection Procedures described in FAR 15.2, DFARS 215.2, and AFARS 5115.2. Evaluation factors include Technical Capability, Past Performance and Price. The Government intends to award a contract without conducting discussions. Interested offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM). To register go to www.SAM.gov. Instructions for registering are on the web page (there is no fee for registration). The solicitation and associated information will be available only from the Contract Opportunities page at SAM.gov. The solicitation and associated information will be posted within Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) Solicitation Module and subsequently uploaded into the Contract Opportunities page at SAM.gov. Per the solicitation requirements, Offerors are required to submit their proposals through the vendor portal for solicitations within the PIEE platform. A Proposal Manager role is required to submit an offer to a solicitation posted in the PIEE Solicitation Module. A PIEE Solicitation Module Vendor Access Instructions is attached. This solicitation is not an invitation for bids and there will not be a formal public bid opening. All inquiries must be in writing, preferably via email to the persons specified in the solicitation. All answers will be provided in writing via posting to SAM.gov. title: Greece – Pumping station construction work – Modifications, construction of a new pumping station & accompanying infrastructure for the interconnection of Kozani district heating with the unified district heating network of Western Macedonia
description: The project concerns the construction of pumping station facilities for the interconnection of Kozani district heating with the new and under construction thermal energy production facilities within the Kardia Thermal Power Plant site through the new thermal energy transfer system under construction, consisting of pipes of nominal diameter DN700mm DN600mm DN450mm with hot/superheated water as the carrier. In detail, it concerns the construction of the following distinct facilities: Installations (pump stations and other equipment) for interconnection in a field granted to DEYAK within the Kardia Thermal Power Plant/PPC referred to as "KARDIAS PUMP STATION". The facilities to be implemented with the project include the following main equipment and works: Hot water circulation pumping station for the transport system. Hot water circulation pump station of the production system Heat exchangers for the hydraulic separation of the existing district heating transport systems DEYAK and production. Other auxiliary equipment (pressure regulation and expansion valve reception, water treatment and replenishment, filtration, addition of chemical additives, safety devices, energy meters, etc.) Connection of the new facilities with the existing or new facilities to be implemented (transport pipeline, production facilities) (water supply, sewage, strong and weak currents and others). Automation control and remote management system for the remote monitoring of the Kardias Pumping Station. The system will fully cooperate with the existing control/remote management system of the district heating facilities control center and will essentially be an extension of it. Installations-renovation works at the existing district heating pumping station in the Kasla area of Kozani (replacement of pumping units of pumping station A2 and other equipment, so that the pumping station meets the requirements of the new transmission system as well as modifications to the routing of the transmission pipelines within the pumping station site), hereinafter referred to as "KASLA PUMP STATION". The works mainly concern Replacement of the main pumping units of pumping station A2 with their accompanying works Replacement of existing transformers with new ones to cover the increased electrical power requirements due to the new equipment. Replacement of existing speed regulators of pumping units of pumping station A1. Modification of the routing of the pre-insulated pipelines of the transmission system within the district heating installation site. Redesign of the existing operational control automation system of the main pumping stations. Upgrading of the supply lines of strong and weak currents of the new pumping complexes. Control automation and remote management system for the remote monitoring of the Kardia Pumping Station (see above-Kardia Pumping Station) as well as the Drepano valve station. The system will fully cooperate with the existing control/remote management system of the district heating installation control center and will essentially be an extension of it. With the implementation of the installations, the nominal transmission capacity of the system will be 195MWth.

description: Conform Hotărârii Guvernului (H.G.) nr. 592/2024 privind organizarea și funcționarea Ministerului Justiției, cu modificările și completările ulterioare, MJ elaborează politicile publice, strategiile și planurile de acțiune în domeniul justiției, al prevenirii și combaterii corupției și formelor grave de criminalitate, inclusiv în concordanță cu obiectivele programului de guvernare și negociază, implementează, monitorizează și evaluează programele internaționale de asistență tehnică și financiară pentru prevenirea criminalității și a corupției, indiferent de instituția beneficiară sau care le implementează. Potrivit art. 6, punctul VI/6 din Hotărârea nr. 592/2024 privind organizarea și funcționarea Ministerului Justiției, cu modificările și completările ulterioare, Ministerul Justiției „coordonează şi îndrumă activitatea economică şi de investiţii a instanţelor judecătoreşti, astfel cum sunt prevăzute în anexa nr. 1 la Legea nr. 304/2022, cu modificările ulterioare, a aparatului propriu şi unităţilor subordonate Ministerului”. Având în vedere importanța tehnologiei informației în susținerea dezvoltării durabile în orice domeniu de activitate, inclusiv în sectorul justiției, atât în contextul e-justiției europene, cât si la nivel național, informatizarea sistemului judiciar reprezintă o componenta strategică în cadrul reformei sistemului judiciar, un pas necesar către un sistem mai transparent, mai accesibil și mai eficient, pavând drumul către o nouă etapă – digitalizarea sistemului judiciar, privită ca fiind procesul de transformare a proceselor si fluxurilor de lucru prin utilizarea instrumentelor digitale în vederea eficientizării acestora. Sub aspect tehnic, mare parte din activitatea instanțelor, subordonatelor Ministerului Justiției, dar și a aparatului propriu se bazează pe utilizarea serviciilor IT gestionate centralizat și furnizate în întreg sistemul judiciar. Această achiziție de produse se realizează în contextul în care necesitatea de distrugere și eliminare într-un timp cât mai scurt a componentelor IT precum și a altor produse similare pot conduce la desfășurarea în bune condiții a activității ministerului și a sistemului judiciar, precum și la diminuarea riscurilor privitoare la siguranța informațiilor pe care aceste dispozitive le pot conține. description: Συνοπτική Περιγραφή φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της Σύμβασης 1.3.1. Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η Προμήθεια ελαστικών επισώτρων για τα οχήματα και μηχανήματα έργου το στόλου του Δήμου, συμπεριλαμβανομένων επισκευαστικών εργασιών για τις ανάγκες του Δήμου σε χρονικό διάστημα 12 μηνών, όπως αναφέρονται και περιγράφονται στις Τεχνικές Προδιαγραφές τα οποία αποτελούν αναπόσπαστα μέρη της Διακήρυξης αυτής, συνολικής εκτιμώμενης αξίας εκατό σαράντα εννέα χιλιάδων εννιακόσιων εβδομήντα οκτώ ευρώ (149.978,00 €) συμπεριλαμβανομένου του Φ.Π.Α. 24% συμπεριλαμβανομένων των υπέρ τρίτων κρατήσεων, ως και κάθε άλλη επιβάρυνση, συμπεριλαμβανομένου Φ.Π.Α., με κριτήριο ανάθεσης τη πλέον συμφέρουσα από οικονομική άποψη προσφορά με βάση την ΧΑΜΗΛΟΤΕΡΗ τιμή. Τα προσφερόμενα από τους διαγωνιζόμενους ελαστικά επίσωτρα (εφεξής και ¨ανταλλακτικά») που προορίζονται για την επισκευή των οχημάτων, μηχανημάτων έργου, πρέπει να είναι ανταλλακτικά της ίδιας ποιότητας µε τα συστατικά που χρησιμοποιούνται κατά την παράδοση ενός νέου οχήματος – υπερκατασκευής και τα οποία παράγονται µε τις τυποποιημένες προδιαγραφές και διαδικασίες που καθορίζει ο κατασκευαστής του οχήματος–υπερκατασκευής, ή ανταλλακτικά εφάμιλλης ποιότητας που κατασκευάζονται από οποιαδήποτε επιχείρηση η οποία μπορεί ανά πάσα στιγμή να πιστοποιήσει ότι τα ανταλλακτικά αυτά έχουν την ίδια ποιότητα µε τα συστατικά μέρη που χρησιμοποιήθηκαν για τη συναρμολόγηση των σχετικών οχημάτων, υπερκατασκευών και πάντα κατά την έννοια του κανονισμού ΕΚ αριθ.1400/2002 ή της αναθεώρησής του (ΕΚ 461/2010) και άριστης ποιότητάς (όχι διαλογής, όχι μεταχειρισμένα, δηλαδή απολύτως καινούρια). Σκοπός της διακήρυξης είναι η κάλυψη των αναγκών του Δήμου Αιγάλεω σε διαθεσιμότητα οχημάτων και κυρίως: Α) Η εξασφάλιση ικανοποιητικής διαθεσιμότητας ετοιμότητας των οχημάτων για τη πλήρη εκμετάλλευση τους. Β) Η εξασφάλιση της προμήθειας των απαραίτητων ελαστικών επισώτρων (συμπεριλαμβανομένης της τοποθέτησης). Η εκάστοτε προμήθεια καθ’ όλη τη διάρκεια της συμφωνίας – πλαίσιο θα γίνεται σύμφωνα με τις διατάξεις των διαδικασιών που προβλέπονται στο Ν. 4412/16 (ΦΕΚ 147/2016 τεύχος Α') Δημόσιες Συμβάσεις Έργων, Προμηθειών και Υπηρεσιών (προσαρμογή στις Οδηγίες 2014/24/ΕΕ και 2014/25/ΕΕ) όπως έχει τροποποιηθεί και ισχύει και τα αναφερόμενα στην Υ.Α 3373/390 (ΦΕΚ 349 Β΄27-03-1975) «περί καθορισμού διαδικασίας επισκευής και συντήρησης, αγοράς ανταλλακτικών και προμήθειας καυσίμων και λιπαντικών κλπ των αυτοκινήτων οχημάτων του Δημοσίου, των Οργανισμών Τοπικής Αυτοδιοίκησης και των εν γένει ΝΠΔΔ κλπ, περί ων το άρθρο 1 του Ν.Δ 2396/53» όπως τροποποιήθηκε με την 4493/24.4.1975 όμοια (ΦΕΚ Β΄489), λαμβάνοντας υπόψη τη σχετική πάγια νομολογία του Ελεγκτικού Συνεδρίου (ενδ. σχετ. 164/2018, 119/2018, 211/2017 πράξεις και 252/2016 ως προς τις νομικές παραδοχές της πράξη, του VII Τμήματος Κλιμακίου Προληπτικού Ελέγχου Δαπανών). Γ) Η παροχή υπηρεσιών για την αποκατάσταση κάθε είδους βλάβης που αιτιολογημένα κάθε φορά, δεν μπορεί να αποκατασταθεί από το συνεργείο επισκευής που διαθέτει ο Δήμος, ενώ θα περιλαμβάνονται και τα τυχόν απαιτούμενα κάθε φορά μικροανταλλακτικά (πχ βαλβίδα αέρος, «μακαρόνι» κλπ). Η αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης δίδεται στα Παραρτήματα: Α΄ «Τεχνική Έκθεση», Β΄ «Τεχνική Περιγραφή-Τεχνικές Προδιαγραφές», Γ΄ «Συγγραφή υποχρεώσεων» και Δ΄ «Ενδεικτικός Προϋπολογισμός» της παρούσας διακήρυξης. 1.3.2. Τα προς προμήθεια είδη κατατάσσονται στον κωδικού του Κοινού Λεξιλογίου δημοσίων συμβάσεων Cpv Περιγραφή Προϋπολογισμός με ΦΠΑ 34351100-3 Ελαστικά επίσωτρα 132.816,40 € 50116500-6 Υπηρεσίες επισκευής, προσαρμογής και ζυγοστάθμισης ελαστικών 17.161,60 € Η παρούσα σύμβαση ΔΕΝ διαχωρίζεται σε Ομάδες. Η διάρκεια της σύμβασης ορίζεται σε δώδεκα (12) μήνες Αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης δίδεται στο παράρτημα των τεχνικών προδιαγραφών της παρούσας διακήρυξης. Η σύμβαση θα ανατεθεί με το κριτήριο της πλέον συμφέρουσας από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει της ΧΑΜΗΛΟΤΕΡΗΣ τιμής.

description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η παροχή υπηρεσιών ψηφιακής εκτύπωσης, τοποθέτησης, αποξήλωσης και αντικατάστασης του υλικού προβολής των παραγωγών που θα παρουσιαστούν από την ΕΛΣ, προκειμένου να μεγιστοποιηθούν τα αποτελέσματα διάχυσής τους. Η εκτιμώμενη αξία της σύμβασης ανέρχεται στο ποσό των 60.000,00 € μη συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ 24 % (εκτιμώμενη αξία συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ: 14.400,00 € ΦΠΑ: 74.400,00 €), με δικαίωμα προαίρεσης μέχρι του ποσού των 30.000,00 € μη συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ 24 %, με τους ίδιους όρους της αρχικής σύμβασης. Η διάρκεια της σύμβασης ορίζεται σε δεκαοκτώ (18) μήνες από την υπογραφή της. Η σύμβαση θα λήξει αυτόματα στην περίπτωση που ο ανάδοχος ολοκληρώσει το έργο του νωρίτερα από το προαναφερόμενο διάστημα. Σε περίπτωση που η αναθέτουσα αρχή το επιθυμεί, διατηρεί το δικαίωμα να παρατείνει τη διάρκεια της σύμβασης ενεργοποιώντας το δικαίωμα προαίρεσης, οπότε στην περίπτωση αυτή η διάρκεια της σύμβασης θα παραταθεί για διάστημα έως εννέα (9) μηνών. Αντίστοιχα, η σύμβαση προαίρεσης θα λήξει αυτόματα στην περίπτωση που ο ανάδοχος ολοκληρώσει το έργο του νωρίτερα από το προαναφερόμενο διάστημα. Αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης δίδεται στο ΠΑΡΑΡΤΗΜΑ I της παρούσας διακήρυξης.
